selected_evidence.requirement: Secure account, key, and host identity configuration
selected_evidence.summary: The authorized-key fingerprint matches node1's key, authorized_keys is mode 600 with correct ownership and SELinux type, and node2's directly captured host-key fingerprint matches the pinned key.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
selected_evidence.summary: Both systems remain RHEL 10.0 and returned on the original 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 kernel.

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! id opsbot >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsbot; fi
passwd -l opsbot >/dev/null
install -d -m 700 -o opsbot -g opsbot /home/opsbot/.ssh
umask 077
cat > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/20-opsbot-key-only.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
Match User opsbot
    PubkeyAuthentication yes
    AuthenticationMethods publickey
    PasswordAuthentication no
    KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
ANTRIEB_EOF
chown root:root /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/20-opsbot-key-only.conf
chmod 600 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/20-opsbot-key-only.conf
restorecon -RF /home/opsbot/.ssh /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/20-opsbot-key-only.conf
if ! /usr/sbin/sshd -t; then rm -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/20-opsbot-key-only.conf; exit 1; fi
systemctl reload sshd
printf 'ACCOUNT='; getent passwd opsbot
printf 'SHADOW_LOCK='; passwd -S opsbot | awk '{print $2}'
printf 'SSHD='; systemctl is-active sshd
commands.stdout:
ACCOUNT=opsbot:x:1000:1000::/home/opsbot:/bin/bash
SHADOW_LOCK=L
SSHD=active
